title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:15:0:00018:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 15 (Procedure for Issuing a Standard Payment)
(1) Any person requesting the issuance of a standard payment must submit a standard payment request form to the post office. However, this does not apply when the request is made by telephone, provided that the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Affairs approves it. (Amended on July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017)
(2) The post office receiving a request in accordance with Article 1(1) shall issue a standard payment certificate and a standard payment receipt to the requester.
